title: Share of 18-34 year-olds living with a parent, by country

source.name: Living arrangements of young adults
source.publisher: Eurostat / U.S. Census Bureau, compiled by Pew Research Center

notes: Pew Research's 2023 comparison of Eurostat and Census Bureau data: 18-34 year-olds living with a parent in 2021 (or nearest year) were 77% in Croatia, 71% in Italy, roughly a third (about 33%) in the United States, and just 17% in Sweden.
